chunks: And in the narration of Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, he said:
"One who fears robbers performs salat by gesturing while on his mount."

key_terms.زُرَارَةَ: Zurārah, the narrator transmitting this report

ai.seo_question: How should a person pray if they fear robbers while traveling?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a person in a state of fear from robbers. It permits performing salat by gesture while remaining on one's mount, showing flexibility in worship during danger.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1343 - In the narration from Zurarah from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:
"One who fears robbers should perform their prayer by gesturing while on their mount”.
